question: Please calculate the growth rates for Asians, Black people, Latinx people, Native Americans, White people, US women, US men, global women, and global men from 2014 to 2024 concerning the overall workforce.
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    workforce,
    report_year,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_native_american,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women,
    gender_us_men,
    gender_global_women,
    gender_global_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall'
)
SELECT 
  'Asian' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((SELECT race_asian FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022) - (SELECT race_asian FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014), 4) AS growth_rate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Black' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((SELECT race_black FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022) - (SELECT race_black FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014), 4) AS growth_rate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Latinx' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((SELECT race_hispanic_latinx FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022) - (SELECT race_hispanic_latinx FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014), 4) AS growth_rate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Native American' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((SELECT race_native_american FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022) - (SELECT race_native_american FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014), 4) AS growth_rate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'White' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((SELECT race_white FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022) - (SELECT race_white FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014), 4) AS growth_rate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'US women' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((SELECT gender_us_women FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022) - (SELECT gender_us_women FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014), 4) AS growth_rate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'US men' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((SELECT gender_us_men FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022) - (SELECT gender_us_men FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014), 4) AS growth_rate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Global women' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((SELECT gender_global_women FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022) - (SELECT gender_global_women FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014), 4) AS growth_rate
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Global men' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((SELECT gender_global_men FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022) - (SELECT gender_global_men FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014), 4) AS growth_rate
